title: Swap Kleenora header logo to uploaded navbar-1.png

requirements.summary: Replace the current header logo asset with the uploaded navbar-1.png and ensure the header renders only the logo image (no additional header text).
acceptanceCriteria: The header logo image source no longer points to the old logo asset (currently "/assets/generated/kleenora-logo.dim_512x200.png").
The header displays the uploaded image navbar-1.png as the site logo on both desktop and mobile.
No additional text label is rendered next to/around the logo in the header.
The logo loads successfully in production build without broken-image fallback.

file_operations.description: Add the uploaded Kleenora logo file to the app's public assets so it is reliably served in production builds.

Update the header logo to reference the new public asset (use /assets/navbar-1.png) instead of /assets/generated/kleenora-logo.dim_512x200.png, and ensure no text label is rendered alongside the logo in the header for both desktop and mobile.
